Keep the main lifts crisp and low-fatigue around MMA. Weighted Chin-up stays the anchor, Human Flag gets two fresh direct exposures, and lower body work is enough to keep strength and pop without stealing from sport.

Weeks 2-4: add small load jumps on Weighted Chin-up, extend One-Leg Tuck Human Flag holds by 1-2 seconds where quality stays high, and keep lower-body volume steady. Week 4 consolidates with a slightly heavier chin-up top exposure, not an all-out test.

If the medial elbow gets hot, first cut 1 back-off set from Weighted Chin-up or reduce the curl dose, keep heavy top work clean, and use straps on Romanian Deadlift if grip irritation is feeding the elbow. For Human Flag, stop each set as soon as the line or shoulder position degrades; if needed, shorten the hold rather than forcing sloppy reps.
